## Report: No Evidence That Boiled Garlic Water Cures COVID-19

The claim that drinking boiled garlic water cures COVID-19 is **false** and has been repeatedly debunked by public health authorities and fact-checkers since early 2020.

**Origin of the claim:** This rumor spread widely on social media in early 2020 as the pandemic began, often via chain messages and viral videos, sometimes falsely attributed to hospitals or medical staff (factcheck.afp.com).

**Official response:** The World Health Organization has explicitly listed garlic (and similar home remedies like vitamin supplements, high heat, or steam) as a "mythbusted" claim, stating there is no evidence garlic protects people from COVID-19, and no cure for the disease exists—only approved medical treatments that reduce severity and speed recovery (who.int).

**Independent fact-checks:** Organizations including FactCheck.org, AFP Fact Check, Africa Check, and India's PIB Fact Check all investigated this specific claim and found no scientific basis for it. Health professionals interviewed as early as February 2020 confirmed there was no evidence supporting garlic water as an effective COVID-19 treatment (factcheck.org, factcheck.afp.com, africacheck.org).

**What the science on garlic actually shows:** Garlic does contain organosulfur compounds with documented antiviral, antimicrobial, and immune-modulating properties in laboratory and some clinical studies unrelated to COVID-19 (ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, PMC7434784). However, having *some* general antiviral properties in a lab setting is entirely different from being a proven "cure" for a specific disease like COVID-19 in humans—no clinical trials have validated garlic water as a treatment or cure for this virus.

**Conclusion:** The belief likely stems from garlic's general reputation for immune benefits, amplified by pandemic-era misinformation. There is no scientific evidence that boiled garlic water cures or prevents COVID-19.

- https://www.factcheck.org/2020/02/fake-coronavirus-cures-part-2-garlic-isnt-a-cure/
